summary: Describes how TCP/IP header fields behave, in the context of header compression. Many fields stay static or change predictably, so understanding their behavior in detail is key to designing a compression scheme. It plays a role like the analysis in RFC 3095 does for other headers. It is informational.

eli5.summary: Packet labels repeat a lot of the same information. This studies which parts stay the same and which change, so a shorthand can be made.
